title: Metrics for Evaluating Dialogue Strategies in a Spoken Language System
claim: Metrics for comparing dialogue strategies in a real-time spoken system: transaction success, contextual appropriateness, normal vs correction turns, and a new implicit-recovery metric; two repair strategies compared.
not_covered: Pre-LLM slot filling; no tool calls, no entity-type ledger, no cascade vs audio-native, no recovery fraction of silent-wrong executions.

title: Empirically Evaluating an Adaptable Spoken Dialogue System
claim: TOOT evaluated with 20 users x 4 tasks (80 dialogues); adaptable version generally outperforms non-adaptable; utility of adaptation depends on initial initiative and confirmation strategies.
not_covered: User-controlled strategy switching; confirmation not measured as recovery of wrong executed actions; no LLM, no entity ledger.

title: Designing and Evaluating an Adaptive Spoken Dialogue System
claim: Rules learned from training dialogues detect a user having ASR trouble; adaptive TOOT tightens strategy to implicit then explicit confirmation of each ASR hypothesis; empirical evaluation shows utility.
not_covered: Adaptation triggered by a user-trouble model, not per-entity confidence; no executed-action ledger, no LLM pipelines, no audio-native arm.

title: Flexible Mixed-Initiative Dialogue Management using Concept-Level Confidence Measures of Speech Recognizer Output
claim: Two concept-level confidence measures from 10-best ASR output; low-confidence interpretations go to confirmation; interpretation accuracy improved 11.5%.
not_covered: Grammar-based slot system; no LLM, no tool execution, no comparison against read-back or instruction-only levers, no acoustic crossing.

title: A Comparison of Confirmation Styles for Error Handling in a Speech Dialog System
claim: Explicit, final and implicit confirmation compared for usability in CAMMIA; final confirmation with fewer turns preferred when no error, explicit preferred when an error occurs.
not_covered: Usability preference study, not a measured recovery fraction; no tool calls, no entity types, no LLM, no acoustic conditions.

title: Sorry, I Didn't Catch That! - An Investigation of Non-understanding Errors and Recovery Strategies
claim: Corpus analysis of non-understanding errors and ten recovery strategies in a room-reservation system; which strategies and user responses lead to recovery; whether a policy can be learned from data.
not_covered: Non-understandings, not silent mis-understandings that execute; no tool execution ledger; pre-LLM.

title: Learning to Ask: When LLM Agents Meet Unclear Instruction
claim: NoisyToolBench of imperfect instructions; LLMs arbitrarily generate missing arguments; Ask-when-Needed prompting makes them ask; ToolEvaluator scores accuracy and efficiency.
not_covered: Instruction-only lever in text for missing arguments, not mis-heard spoken entities; no speech, no confidence gating, no read-back oracle, no silent-wrong recovery fraction.

title: Ask-before-Plan: Proactive Language Agents for Real-World Planning
claim: Proactive Agent Planning task: predict clarification needs, gather information with tools, plan; CEP multi-agent framework with trajectory tuning.
not_covered: Planning ambiguity in text; no speech, no entity mis-hearing, no per-lever cost accounting.

title: When2Call: When (not) to Call Tools
claim: Benchmark of tool-usage decisions: call, ask for clarification, or recognise tools cannot answer; leading models have significant room for improvement; preference optimisation helps.
not_covered: Text decisions only; no ASR entity errors, no read-back, no recovery fraction.

title: Structured Uncertainty guided Clarification for LLM Agents
claim: Structured uncertainty over tool parameters and domains with EVPI question selection and cost modeling; SAGE-Agent 7-39% higher coverage with 1.5-2.7x fewer questions; uncertainty-weighted GRPO lifts When2Call; introduces ClarifyBench.
not_covered: Uncertainty over what the user wants, not what the ASR heard; no speech pipelines, no acoustic conditions, no read-back-vs-gating comparison.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain
claim: Information Gain Reward trains a clarifier in a clarification-enhanced tau-Bench; +3.7% success over no-clarification while adding only 0.3 interaction steps on average.
not_covered: Turn cost reported for text underspecification; no speech, no entity errors, no confirmation of heard values.

title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
claim: AskBench turns QA pairs into multi-turn interactions with checkpoints and a judge loop; AskMind and AskOverconfidence settings; rubric-guided RLVR improves accuracy and interaction efficiency.
not_covered: QA not tool execution; no speech; no confirmation of a heard value.

title: Knowing but Not Showing: LLMs Recognize Ambiguity but Rarely Ask Clarifying Questions
claim: Models identify ambiguity when asked to judge it but overwhelmingly answer directly in QA; retrieved context widens the gap.
not_covered: Asking calibration in text QA only; no tool calls, no speech.

title: Ambig-DS: A Benchmark for Task-Framing Ambiguity in Data-Science Agents
claim: Silent misframing: agents commit to plausible but unintended framings producing clean executable artifacts; one clarifying question recovers much of the loss; agents cannot tell when to ask (over-ask vs silent default).
not_covered: Text data-science tasks; no speech, no ASR, no entity types, no confidence gating or read-back. Text analogue of the silent-wrong cell.

title: When Search Agents Should Ask: DiscoBench for Clarification-Aware Deep Search
claim: 211 samples / 463 ambiguity instances with a user simulator; evaluates task utility, ambiguity detection, interaction strategy and cost efficiency; searching instead of asking often worse than guessing.
not_covered: Search agents; no side-effecting tool execution, no speech.

title: LHAW: Controllable Underspecification for Long-Horizon Tasks
claim: Pipeline removing information along Goals/Constraints/Inputs/Context at set severities, validated by agent trials; cost-sensitive evaluation of clarification in long-horizon settings.
not_covered: Long-horizon software tasks; no speech, no entity mis-hearing.

title: CLAIM: Leading Open-domain Active Clarification of Large Language Models with Uncertainty Measurement
claim: Entropy of answer disagreement across models labels when and what to clarify; SFT+GRPO trains a clarification decision model without human labels.
not_covered: Open-domain QA uncertainty; no ASR n-best disagreement, no tool calls.

title: AgentAbstain: Do LLM Agents Know When Not to Act?
claim: 263 paired should-act/should-abstain tasks across 42 sandboxes; best agent 59.5% paired accuracy; abstention independent of task-solving; post-hoc abstention after irreversible actions.
not_covered: Abstention triggered by ambiguity, conflicts or tool failure in text, not by a mis-heard parameter; no speech, no lever recovery.

title: The Confidence Dichotomy: Analyzing and Mitigating Miscalibration in Tool-Use Agents
claim: Evidence tools induce overconfidence, verification tools mitigate it; RL jointly optimising accuracy and calibration generalises across domains.
not_covered: Confidence about answers, not heard parameters; no speech; no gating policy evaluated as a recovery lever.

title: Exploring Agentic Tool-Calling Decisions via Uncertainty-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
claim: TRUST adds uncertainty quantification as a repulsive reward term to keep uncertainty separation between correct and incorrect tool decisions; key-turn annotations for multi-turn post-training.
not_covered: Text tool-use decision quality; no speech, no confirmation.

title: CaRT: Teaching LLM Agents to Know When They Know Enough
claim: Counterfactual trajectory pairs teach when to stop gathering information and act (medical diagnosis, math); improves efficiency and success.
not_covered: Termination of information gathering, not confirmation of a value; no speech.

title: UserBench: An Interactive Gym Environment for User-Centric Agents
claim: Simulated users with underspecified goals revealing preferences incrementally; full intent alignment only ~20%; best models uncover <30% of preferences.
not_covered: Preference elicitation in text; no speech, no entity errors, no parameter confirmation.

title: AppWorld-UL: Benchmarking Diverse Agent-User Interactions for Tool-Use
claim: 516 tasks over 9 apps requiring clarification, prompting for confirmation, or reporting infeasibility; LLM-simulated user with knowledge boundaries; Claude Opus 4.7 48.6% success, 21.3% strict compositional.
not_covered: Confirmation is a required behaviour class, not a lever measured for recovery; text instructions, no ASR, no acoustic conditions, no entity ledger.

title: CAR-bench: Evaluating the Consistency and Limit-Awareness of LLM Agents under Real-World Uncertainty
claim: In-car assistant domain with 58 tools and LLM-simulated user; Hallucination and Disambiguation tasks; frontier LLMs <50% consistent pass on Disambiguation due to premature actions.
not_covered: Voice-assistant domain but text-simulated user: no audio, no ASR, no mis-heard entities, no read-back lever.

title: SAFETY SENTRY: Context-Aware Human Intervention via EXECUTE-ASK-REFUSE Routing
claim: Per-instance three-way routing EXECUTE/ASK/REFUSE with one decoding-time threshold; routine interruptions train users to wave through consequential alerts.
not_covered: ASK triggered by harm or context risk, not parameter-hearing uncertainty; no speech, no recovery measurement.

title: When Should Users Check? Modeling Confirmation Frequency in Multi-Step Agentic AI Tasks
claim: Confirmation placement as minimum-time scheduling; CDCR pattern; 48-participant study: 81% prefer intermediate confirmation over confirm-at-end, task time -13.54%.
not_covered: Measures confirmation cost for human monitoring of multi-step tasks; no speech, no entity errors, no per-call recovery fraction.

title: The Verifiable Action Card: Trustworthy Human-in-the-Loop Control for Secure Autonomous Agents
claim: Approval reconstructed from the ground-truth pending browser action, rendered out-of-band and bound at dispatch; attack success 68-100% -> 0% with 78% legitimate completion.
not_covered: Security against forged confirmations, not accuracy of heard parameters; no speech.

title: AgentSpec: Customizable Runtime Enforcement for Safe and Reliable LLM Agents
claim: DSL of triggers/predicates/enforcement for runtime agent constraints; prevents >90% unsafe code executions and all hazardous embodied actions at ms overhead.
not_covered: Rule-based safety boundaries; a schema-valid wrong amount passes every rule; no speech.

title: Learning When to Act or Refuse: Guarding Agentic Reasoning Models for Safe Multi-Step Tool Use
claim: MOSAIC plan-check-act-or-refuse loop with refusal as a first-class action trained by preference RL; harmful behaviour -50%, benign performance preserved.
not_covered: Refusal for harmful tasks, not clarification for uncertain values; no speech.

title: From Helpfulness to Toxic Proactivity: Diagnosing Behavioral Misalignment in LLM Agents
claim: Toxic Proactivity: agents take excessive or manipulative measures to stay useful; dilemma-driven dual-model evaluation and benchmark.
not_covered: Behavioural misalignment; not over-confident execution of a mis-heard value.

title: Proactive for Uncertainty: Cause-Aware Error Diagnosis and Interactive Clarification for Spoken Dialogue Systems
claim: Cascaded ASR-LLM SDS: ASR confidence filtering misses deletions and cannot separate acoustic from linguistic errors; detectors over ASR latents drive targeted multi-turn clarification; recall 57.96% vs 23.66%, up to 30% WER cut and 17% downstream gain across accents and distortions.
not_covered: Cascade only; clarification of transcript errors, not a ledger of schema-valid wrong tool calls by entity type; no read-back oracle, no lever comparison on recovery fraction and turn cost. NEAR.

title: AVERT: Audio-Verified Adjudication for Spoken Dialogue State Tracking
claim: ASR errors concentrate in entity values and persist across turns; audio-conditioned verifier plus cross-turn vote/add/swap lifts SpokenWOZ JGA from 33.04/38.34 to 40.13.
not_covered: Silent post-hoc verifier, not user-facing confirmation; DST slots, not executed tool calls; no recovery fraction, no audio-native tool-calling arm.

title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
claim: Converts Confetti and When2Call to audio via TTS, speaker variation and noise keeping gold labels; 7 omni models; text-to-voice gap 1.8-4.8 points; degradations most often reflect misunderstandings of argument values in speech.
not_covered: Audio-native models only (no local-ASR cascade arm); aggregate gap not a silent-wrong ledger by entity type; no read-back, confidence gating or ask-when-unsure comparison; no telephone band or rate. NEAR.
